UPDATE lojas
SET 
  nome = $1,
  whatsapp_loja = CASE WHEN $2 != '' THEN $2 ELSE whatsapp_loja END,
  ativo = $3,
  config_json = jsonb_set(
    CASE 
      WHEN ($4::jsonb->'evolutionapi'->>'apikey') IS NULL 
        OR ($4::jsonb->'evolutionapi'->>'apikey') = '' 
        OR ($4::jsonb->'evolutionapi'->>'apikey') = '***'
      THEN jsonb_set(
        $4::jsonb, 
        '{evolutionapi,apikey}', 
        COALESCE(to_jsonb(config_json->'evolutionapi'->>'apikey'), '""'::jsonb)
      )
      ELSE $4::jsonb
    END,
    '{evolutionapi,token}',
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(to_jsonb($4::jsonb->'evolutionapi'->>'token'), '""'::jsonb),
      to_jsonb(config_json->'evolutionapi'->>'token'),
      '""'::jsonb
    )
  ),
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $5
RETURNING *;

UPDATE lojas
SET config_json = $1::jsonb, updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $2
RETURNING *;
